counter_evidence_candidates.description: Look for trade downturn cases where external demand shock was not the primary driver.
Look for cases where NODX weakened despite stable or improving global trade conditions.
Look for domestic-policy or sector-specific explanations that outperform external demand shock.

counter_reviews.governance_note: Absence of observed counter-evidence is not proof of validity. It only means no blocking counter-evidence has been registered yet.
